topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: When my neighbor approached me with the idea of using a corner of our yard for a garden, I felt an immediate warmth spread through me. It’s a beautiful stretch of land, just waiting for life to bloom there. I could see the hope in their eyes, the sparkle of potential. Of course, I said yes, without a moment’s hesitation. I even offered to help with the preparations, to dig and plant, and perhaps share in the harvest. It feels wonderful to see that plot transform, not just with flowers and vegetables, but with the growth of our friendship as well.
